title: recordverdict and the learning block's verdict organs retire; cairn review is the one gate act
intention: The approve/disprove verdict intake is gone: the recordverdict command and verb and learning_block's record_verdict, pending_findings, answered_finding_ids and emit_finding are deleted; `cairn review` is the one gate act the operator's surfaces name; CairnCommons/learning/records stays a read-only record.
why: Akien's outline at 5.10.8 of CairnComponentOutline[BACKUP].txt: 'Retired already: recordverdict (→ review), ruling and ruled (→ question)'; 1.3.7: 'Code that is no longer needed is deleted'; 7.4.3: cairn review <id> "<words>". 0fe1ccbfd33b (PROVED 2026-08-29) retired the CLI by a note only, leaving the verb, the primitive and five surfaces naming it live.
how: Extend the shared retirement proof and whatslefttodo's proof red first; delete the command, the verb and the four dead organs; whatslefttodo's rulings gather reads skill_block.pending_reviews; tellmeabout, proofs, prose and charters stop naming the intake.

clauses.claim: no repo file outside records of truth and caches names `cairn recordverdict`, bin/cmd/recordverdict, a definition or call of record_verdict, pending_findings, answered_finding_ids or emit_finding
learning_block.learning_block has none of record_verdict, pending_findings, answered_finding_ids, emit_finding, and `python3 -m cairn.machines.learning_block recordverdict` exits nonzero
whatslefttodo's live rulings gather equals the review queue: count = len(skill_block.pending_reviews()), oldest_id = its first berth_id

decisions.text: D1: red-first teeth. bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py gains PROVES['e5a8e8059296'] = {'1': 'recordverdict_paths_are_absent', '2': 'nothing_names_recordverdict', '3': 'learning_block_has_no_verdict_organs'} and a _recordverdict() called from check(), modeled on _ruling(): tooth 1, bin/cmd/recordverdict is absent under REPO; tooth 2, _naming over ('cairn ' + 'recordverdict', 'bin/cmd/' + 'recordverdict', 'def ' + 'record_verdict', '.' + 'record_verdict(', 'pending_' + 'findings', 'answered_' + 'finding_ids', 'emit_' + 'finding') (each spelled split) finds nothing; tooth 3, one subprocess from REPO imports cairn.machines.learning_block.learning_block and prints which of record_verdict, pending_findings, answered_finding_ids, emit_finding it still has (expected none), and a second subprocess `python3 -m cairn.machines.learning_block recordverdict` exits nonzero. The docstring gains a section for this ticket. skills/whatslefttodo/proofs/test_whatslefttodo.py gains module-level PROVES = {'e5a8e8059296': {'4': 'the_rulings_gather_reads_the_review_queue'}} and, after the live-world shape teeth, ok('the_rulings_gather_reads_the_review_queue', ...) asserting w['rulings_count'] == len(pending_reviews()) and w['rulings_oldest_id'] == (pending[0]['berth_id'] if pending else None), with pending_reviews from cairn.machines.skill_block.skill_block. Run red before the build: all four FAIL.
D2: delete bin/cmd/recordverdict by git rm (it is a plain script; it has no charter, history, state or validations).

D3: cairn/machines/learning_block/__main__.py loses the recordverdict verb: its docstring lines about it, its entry in _USAGE, _recordverdict whole, its branch in main, and the find_paired_sorted import; trace and dial stay. cairn/machines/learning_block/learning_block.py loses emit_finding, record_verdict, pending_findings, answered_finding_ids, learning_records_dir, STRATA, SIGNALS, FindingRefused and VerdictRefused (and any import only they used); the module docstring stops listing the FINDING and VERDICT organs and says they retired with the recordverdict intake (ticket e5a8e8059296, outline 5.10.8), and that dial still reads the trace's historical 'finding' and 'verdict' events read-only. cairn/machines/skill_block/__main__.py stops importing FindingRefused and catches SkillBlockRefused alone.

D4: cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/test_learning_block.py: delete the finding teeth, the verdict teeth (the _finding helper, test_verdict_conforms..., test_approve_and_disprove..., test_verdict_without...), test_pending_findings_rule and test_recordverdict_shell_door. The dial teeth build their fixtures with lb.write_trace(block, 'finding', 'training', {...}, now=NOW, root=root) and lb.write_trace(block, 'verdict', 'training', {'signal': ..., 'finding_id': ...}, now=NOW, root=root) instead of the deleted writers; the hand-counts they assert are unchanged (findings 3, approvals 1, disproves 1, questions 1, match_rate 0.5; one more approve gives 2/3).

D5: whatslefttodo's rulings gather reads the review queue. skills/whatslefttodo/door.py: the instrument for 'rulings' is ('review',); the live reader imports pending_reviews from cairn.machines.skill_block.skill_block, count = len, oldest_id = pending[0]['berth_id'] or None; the stale-count message says 're-run bin/cmd/review and refire' and names artifacts awaiting review, not findings; the docstring's RULINGS line names skill_block.pending_reviews. skills/whatslefttodo/SKILL.md: the RULINGS section runs bin/cmd/review (bare: lists artifacts awaiting review) and the packet example has "ran": "bin/cmd/review". skills/whatslefttodo/intention+why.json (write_json, verb append, why 'ticket e5a8e8059296: recordverdict retires; cairn review is the one gate act (outline 5.10.8)'): what, input_contract.rulings, writes_to, counted_by and proof name bin/cmd/review and pending_reviews where they named the old command. skills/whatslefttodo/proofs/test_whatslefttodo.py: the fixture and live packets' 'ran' become bin/cmd/review and the stale-count tooth asserts 'review' in the rulings whys.

D6: skills/tellmeabout/tellmeabout.py: the findings store keeps reading historical trace records, but nothing can be pending any more: drop the answered/pending split; waiting_on for a finding is 'nothing — the approve/disprove intake retired (ticket e5a8e8059296); any answer it took is in the verdict records under CairnCommons/learning/records'; the docstring lines naming the old command say the intake retired. skills/tellmeabout/SKILL.md lines about the pending-finding waiting act and the multi-match refusal stop naming it. skills/tellmeabout/intention+why.json (write_json, verb append, why 'ticket e5a8e8059296: recordverdict retires; cairn review is the one gate act (outline 5.10.8)'): why and counted_by.why_not_a_ledger say his verdicts are reviews (`cairn review`). skills/tellmeabout/proofs/test_tellmeabout.py: the pending-finding tooth and its comment go; the answered tooth stands and asserts the new waiting words.

D7: cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_system_word.py: delete PROVES key '4' and test_learning_block_takes_uppercase_recordverdict_and_signal; the fold_head tooth's docstring says 'the review words' and its example uses 'review' for the head. bin/proofs/test_cairn_command.py: delete test_recordverdict_registration_is_wired_end_to_end and its runner entry. cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py: delete test_emit_finding_subject_kwarg and its runner entry. cairn/tools/operator_inbox/probes/operator_inbox_matches_live_state.py line 56's comment says 'the retired findings reader read 0' without the function name.

D8: prose and charters. bin/cmd/artifactgate: DOOR_FORMS drops the retired command (cairn review stays). skills/intent/SKILL.md line 145: it stands at his gate until `cairn review` names it. Charters (write_json, verb append, why 'ticket e5a8e8059296: recordverdict retires; cairn review is the one gate act (outline 5.10.8)'): cairn/machines/learning_block/intention+why.json invoke drops the recordverdict verb and filed_edges stop naming it as live; bin/intention+why.json how_it_learns names `cairn review` where it names the retired command; cairn/machines/skill_block/intention+why.json for_whom stops naming it.

D9: recompile the lab (cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh). Run bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py green twice, and once each skills/whatslefttodo/proofs/test_whatslefttodo.py, cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/test_learning_block.py, skills/tellmeabout/proofs/test_tellmeabout.py, cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_system_word.py, bin/proofs/test_cairn_command.py, cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py, cairn/machines/skill_block/proofs and bin/proofs/test_artifact_gate.py; commit; seal; PROVEME; hollow seal; forwarding order for bin/cmd/recordverdict after the deletion.

out: learning_block's trace, dial and door (they stay)
codemother's and chain's own VerdictRefused (a different class)

measured.saw: emit_finding has no caller outside learning_block's and operator_inbox's proofs; record_verdict is called only by the learning_block verb; pending_findings() returns 0 and is read by whatslefttodo's door, the verb and tellmeabout's proof; answered_finding_ids has no caller; skill_block __main__ imports FindingRefused; 12 learning records, newest 2026-08-28; the review queue holds 118
measured.how: git grep over class-space for the names; a python call of pending_findings; ls CairnCommons/learning/records; bin/cmd/review
